797	# Error bodies appear as direct code/message pairs, error.code/error.message, or
798	# another JSON error encoded inside error.message. Normalize all three shapes.
799	function script:Get-CopilotApiError {
800	    param($Body, [int] $Depth = 0)
801	    $raw = ConvertTo-CopilotCompactText $Body
802	    if ($Depth -gt 4) {
803	        return [pscustomobject]@{ Code = $null; Message = $null; Raw = $raw }
804	    }
805	
806	    $object = $Body
807	    if ($Body -is [string]) {
808	        try { $object = $Body | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop }
809	        catch { return [pscustomobject]@{ Code = $null; Message = $null; Raw = $raw } }
810	    }
811	    if (-not $object) { return [pscustomobject]@{ Code = $null; Message = $null; Raw = $raw } }
812	
813	    $container = $object
814	    if ($object.PSObject.Properties['error']) {
815	        $container = $object.error
816	        if ($container -is [string]) {
817	            $nestedError = Get-CopilotApiError -Body $container -Depth ($Depth + 1)
818	            if ($nestedError.Code -or $nestedError.Message) { return $nestedError }
819	        }
820	    }
821	
822	    $code = if ($container.PSObject.Properties['code']) { [string]$container.code } else { $null }
823	    $message = if ($container.PSObject.Properties['message']) { [string]$container.message } else { $null }
824	    if ($message -and $message.TrimStart().StartsWith('{')) {
825	        $nestedMessage = Get-CopilotApiError -Body $message -Depth ($Depth + 1)
826	        if ($nestedMessage.Code -or $nestedMessage.Message) {
827	            return [pscustomobject]@{
828	                Code    = if ($nestedMessage.Code) { $nestedMessage.Code } else { $code }
829	                Message = if ($nestedMessage.Message) { $nestedMessage.Message } else { $message }
830	                Raw     = $raw
831	            }
832	        }
833	    }
834	    [pscustomobject]@{ Code = $code; Message = $message; Raw = $raw }
835	}
836	
837	function script:Classify-CopilotInferenceError {
838	    param([int] $StatusCode, $Body)
839	    $errorInfo = Get-CopilotApiError -Body $Body
840	    $code = ([string]$errorInfo.Code).ToLowerInvariant()
841	    $detailParts = @($errorInfo.Code, $errorInfo.Message) | Where-Object { $_ }
842	    $detail = $detailParts -join ': '
843	    if (-not $detail) { $detail = $errorInfo.Raw }
844	
845	    if ($StatusCode -eq 402 -and $code -eq 'billing_not_configured') {
846	        return [pscustomobject]@{
847	            Kind        = 'BillingNotConfigured'
848	            Code        = $errorInfo.Code
849	            Message     = $errorInfo.Message
850	            Summary     = "account-wide GitHub Copilot billing is not configured: $detail"
851	            Retryable   = $false
852	            AccountWide = $true
853	            Action      = 'https://github.com/settings/copilot/features'
854	            Guidance    = 'Select an organization or enterprise in GitHub''s "Usage billed to" setting. Changing the model, using --auto, or enabling the shim cannot fix this account-wide failure.'
855	        }
856	    }
857	
858	    if ($code -match '^(model_not_supported|model_unsupported|unsupported_model)$') {
859	        return [pscustomobject]@{
860	            Kind        = 'ModelUnsupported'
861	            Code        = $errorInfo.Code
862	            Message     = $errorInfo.Message
863	            Summary     = $detail
864	            Retryable   = $false
865	            AccountWide = $false
866	            Action      = 'Run copilot-model --auto, or copilot-model -l and select a model advertised by the live catalog.'
867	            Guidance    = $null
868	        }
869	    }
870	
871	    [pscustomobject]@{
872	        Kind        = 'HttpError'
873	        Code        = $errorInfo.Code
874	        Message     = $errorInfo.Message
875	        Summary     = $detail
876	        Retryable   = ($StatusCode -eq 429 -or $StatusCode -ge 500)
877	        AccountWide = $false
878	        Action      = $null
879	        Guidance    = $null
880	    }
881	}

883	# Convert a raw proxy id to the spelling Claude Code should receive. A live
884	# max_context_window_tokens >= 1M earns [1m]. Offline, preserve an explicitly
885	# stored suffix but do not invent one.
886	function script:ConvertTo-CopilotClaudeModel {
887	    param([Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Model, $Catalog)
888	    $hadHint = $Model -match '\[1m\]$'
889	    $raw = Remove-CopilotContextHint $Model
890	    if (-not $PSBoundParameters.ContainsKey('Catalog')) { $Catalog = Get-CopilotModelCatalog }
891	    if ($Catalog) {
892	        $entry = $Catalog.data | Where-Object { $_.id -eq $raw } | Select-Object -First 1
893	        $context = $entry.capabilities.limits.max_context_window_tokens
894	        if ($context -and [long]$context -ge 1000000) { return "$raw[1m]" }
895	        return $raw
896	    }
897	    if ($hadHint) { return "$raw[1m]" }
898	    $raw
899	}

907	# Build the complete Claude Code role profile for a selected main model. Native
908	# Claude profiles use the strongest served model in each family. OpenAI profiles
909	# map quality/balanced/fast work to the selected main, Terra and Luna.
910	function script:Get-CopilotModelProfile {
911	    param([string] $Model = (Get-CopilotDefaultModel), $Catalog)
912	    if (-not $PSBoundParameters.ContainsKey('Catalog')) { $Catalog = Get-CopilotModelCatalog }
913	    $models = Get-CopilotCatalogIds $Catalog
914	    $raw = Remove-CopilotContextHint $Model
915	    $main = ConvertTo-CopilotClaudeModel -Model $Model -Catalog $Catalog
916	
917	    $fableRaw = $raw; $opusRaw = $raw; $sonnetRaw = $raw; $haikuRaw = $raw
918	    if ($raw -like 'claude-*') {
919	        $fableRaw = Select-CopilotFirstServed -Model $models -Candidate @('claude-fable-5')
920	        if (-not $fableRaw) { $fableRaw = @($models | Where-Object { $_ -like 'claude-fable-*' } | Sort-Object)[-1] }
921	        if (-not $fableRaw) { $fableRaw = $raw }
922	
923	        $opusRaw = Select-CopilotFirstServed -Model $models -Candidate @(
924	            'claude-opus-5', 'claude-opus-4-8', 'claude-opus-4-7', 'claude-opus-4-6', 'claude-opus-4-5'
925	        )
926	        if (-not $opusRaw) { $opusRaw = @($models | Where-Object { $_ -like 'claude-opus-*' } | Sort-Object)[-1] }
927	        if (-not $opusRaw) { $opusRaw = $raw }
928	
929	        $sonnetRaw = Select-CopilotFirstServed -Model $models -Candidate @(
930	            'claude-sonnet-5', 'claude-sonnet-4-6', 'claude-sonnet-4-5'
931	        )
932	        if (-not $sonnetRaw) { $sonnetRaw = @($models | Where-Object { $_ -like 'claude-sonnet-*' } | Sort-Object)[-1] }
933	        if (-not $sonnetRaw) { $sonnetRaw = $raw }
934	
935	        $haikuRaw = Select-CopilotFirstServed -Model $models -Candidate @('claude-haiku-4-5')
936	        if (-not $haikuRaw) { $haikuRaw = @($models | Where-Object { $_ -like 'claude-haiku-*' } | Sort-Object)[-1] }
937	        if (-not $haikuRaw) { $haikuRaw = $raw }
938	    }
939	    elseif ($raw -like 'gpt-*' -or $raw -match 'codex') {
940	        $sonnetRaw = Select-CopilotFirstServed -Model $models -Candidate @('gpt-5.6-terra')
941	        if (-not $sonnetRaw) { $sonnetRaw = $raw }
942	        $haikuRaw = Select-CopilotFirstServed -Model $models -Candidate @('gpt-5.6-luna', 'gpt-5.4-mini', 'gpt-5-mini')
943	        if (-not $haikuRaw) { $haikuRaw = $raw }
944	    }
945	
946	    [ordered]@{
947	        main   = $main
948	        fable  = ConvertTo-CopilotClaudeModel -Model $fableRaw -Catalog $Catalog
949	        opus   = ConvertTo-CopilotClaudeModel -Model $opusRaw -Catalog $Catalog
950	        sonnet = ConvertTo-CopilotClaudeModel -Model $sonnetRaw -Catalog $Catalog
951	        haiku  = ConvertTo-CopilotClaudeModel -Model $haikuRaw -Catalog $Catalog
952	    }
953	}

964	# "<model>|<source>" — the model Claude Code would send from this directory.
965	function script:Get-CopilotEffectiveModel {
966	    param([string] $Settings = '.claude/settings.local.json')
967	    $settings = $Settings
968	    if (Test-Path $settings) {
969	        try {
970	            $j = Get-Content -Raw $settings | ConvertFrom-Json
971	            if ($j.env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL) {
972	                $m = $j.env.ANTHROPIC_MODEL
973	                if ($m) { return "$m|project pin: $settings" }
974	                return "|project pin missing ANTHROPIC_MODEL: $settings"
975	            }
976	        } catch { $null = $_ }
977	    }
978	    if ($env:COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL) { return "$($env:COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL)|`$COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL" }
979	    $sf = Get-CopilotModelState

984	# The EXACT env block `copilot-here on` / `copilot-run` would apply right now.
985	#
986	# SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for three callers: copilot-run (process env),
987	# `copilot-here on` (what it merges into settings.local.json) and
988	# Get-CopilotHereDrift (what it compares against). These used to be hand-maintained
989	# copies and they diverged — the drift check compared 4 of the 8 keys `on` writes,
990	# so a pin missing ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL / ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL /
991	# CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC reported "no drift" while `on` would
992	# still have changed it. Add a key here and all three follow.
993	#
994	# -Pinned uses the shim base when the shim is enabled but not yet up (what a
995	# written-to-disk pin should say); copilot-run wants the live base instead.
996	function script:Get-CopilotEnvBlock {
997	    param([switch] $Pinned, [string] $Model = (Get-CopilotDefaultModel), $Catalog)
998	    $modelProfile = if ($PSBoundParameters.ContainsKey('Catalog')) {
999	        Get-CopilotModelProfile -Model $Model -Catalog $Catalog
1000	    } else {
1001	        Get-CopilotModelProfile -Model $Model
1002	    }
1003	    $block = [ordered]@{
1004	        ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL             = if ($Pinned) { Get-CopilotPinnedBase } else { Get-CopilotClientBase }
1005	        ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN           = 'dummy'
1006	        ANTHROPIC_MODEL                = $modelProfile.main
1007	        ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_FABLE_MODEL  = $modelProfile.fable
1008	        ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL   = $modelProfile.opus
1009	        ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL = $modelProfile.sonnet
1010	        ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL  = $modelProfile.haiku
1011	        ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL     = $modelProfile.haiku
1012	        CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC = '1'
1013	    }
1014	    if ($env:COPILOT_PROXY_QUIET -eq '1') {
1015	        $block.CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER = '0'
1016	        $block.CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_PROMPT_SUGGESTION = 'false'
1017	        $block.CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AWAY_SUMMARY = '0'
1018	        $block.DISABLE_NON_ESSENTIAL_MODEL_CALLS = '1'
1019	    }
1020	    $block
1021	}

1023	# --- shim start/stop ---
1024	function script:Start-CopilotShim {
1025	    if (Test-CopilotShimAlive) { return $true }
1026	    if (-not (Get-Command bun -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
1027	        Write-Error "copilot-proxy: shim needs 'bun' (scoop install bun)"; return $false
1028	    }
1029	    $script = Get-CopilotShimScript
1030	    if (-not (Test-Path $script)) { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: shim script not found at $script"; return $false }
1031	    $env:COPILOT_SHIM_PORT = Get-CopilotShimPort
1032	    $env:COPILOT_SHIM_UPSTREAM = Get-CopilotBase
1033	    $p = Start-Process -FilePath 'bun' -ArgumentList @($script) -PassThru -WindowStyle Hidden `
1034	        -RedirectStandardOutput (Get-CopilotShimLog) -RedirectStandardError "$(Get-CopilotShimLog).err"
1035	    $p.Id | Set-Content -Path (Get-CopilotShimPid)
1036	    for ($i = 0; $i -lt 10; $i++) { if (Test-CopilotShimAlive) { return $true }; Start-Sleep 1 }
1037	    Write-Error "copilot-proxy: shim did not come up — check $(Get-CopilotShimLog)"; $false
1038	}
1039	function script:Stop-CopilotShim {
1040	    $pidf = Get-CopilotShimPid
1041	    if (Test-Path $pidf) {
1042	        $pid_ = Get-Content -First 1 $pidf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
1043	        if ($pid_) { Stop-Process -Id $pid_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
1044	        Remove-Item $pidf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
1045	    }
1046	    Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name = 'bun.exe'" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
1047	        Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like '*copilot-throttle-shim.js*' } |
1048	        ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
1049	}

1051	# ============================================================ copilot-proxy ===
1052	function copilot-proxy {
1053	    [CmdletBinding()]
1054	    param([Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments)] [string[]] $Argv)
1055	
1056	    if (-not (Get-Command bun -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
1057	        Write-Error "copilot-proxy: bun not found (scoop install bun)"; return
1058	    }
1059	
1060	    $port = Get-CopilotPort; $pkg = Get-CopilotPkg
1061	    $logf = Get-CopilotLogFile; $pidf = Get-CopilotPidFile
1062	    $action = if ($Argv -and $Argv.Count -ge 1) { $Argv[0] } else { 'status' }
1063	
1064	    switch ($action) {
1065	        'start' {
1066	            if (Test-CopilotAlive) { Write-Host "copilot-proxy: already running on port $port"; return }
1067	            if (-not (Test-Path (Get-CopilotToken))) {
1068	                Write-Error "copilot-proxy: not authenticated yet — run 'copilot-proxy auth' first."; return
1069	            }
1070	            # Rotate the previous session's log (keep last 3).
1071	            if (Test-Path $logf) {
1072	                Remove-Item "$logf.3" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
1073	                if (Test-Path "$logf.2") { Move-Item -Force "$logf.2" "$logf.3" }
1074	                if (Test-Path "$logf.1") { Move-Item -Force "$logf.1" "$logf.2" }
1075	                Move-Item -Force $logf "$logf.1"
1076	            }
1077	            # Install the pinned package BEFORE launching anything. Resolving it at
1078	            # launch (the old `bunx <pkg> start`) is what used to hang forever behind
1079	            # a socks proxy, with nothing but "Resolving dependencies" in the log.
1080	            if (-not (Install-CopilotPkg)) { return }
1081	            $launch = Get-CopilotPkgLaunch
1082	            if (-not $launch) { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: no runnable copilot-api after install"; return }
1083	
1084	            # Node ignores the Windows System Proxy — it only honours HTTP(S)_PROXY,
1085	            # and the fork additionally needs --proxy-env before its fetch uses them.
1086	            $httpProxy = Resolve-CopilotHttpProxy
1087	            if ($httpProxy) {
1088	                Write-Host "copilot-proxy: Node will fetch /models via $httpProxy (--proxy-env; COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=$(if ($env:COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY) { $env:COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY } else { 'auto' }))"
1089	            } elseif ($env:COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY -in 'always', 'on', '1', 'true', 'yes') {
1090	                Write-Warning "copilot-proxy: COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=always but no proxy detected — starting DIRECT (the Claude catalog may be geo-filtered)."
1091	                Write-Host "  hint: enable the Clash/Verge System Proxy, or set COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:7897"
1092	            }
1093	
1094	            $argList = @($launch.Pre + @('start', '--port', $port))
1095	            if ((Get-CopilotPkgFlavor) -eq 'original') {
1096	                $rate = if ($env:COPILOT_PROXY_RATE) { $env:COPILOT_PROXY_RATE } else { '15' }
1097	                # Original package: HTTPS_PROXY alone is enough (it has no --proxy-env).
1098	                $argList += @('--rate-limit', $rate, '--wait')
1099	                Write-Host "copilot-proxy: starting ($pkg) on port $port (rate-limit ${rate}s) ..."
1100	            } else {
1101	                if ($httpProxy) { $argList += '--proxy-env' }
1102	                Write-Host "copilot-proxy: starting ($pkg) on port $port ..."
1103	            }
1104	
1105	            # Scope the proxy env to the child: set, spawn, restore.
1106	            $proxyVars = 'HTTP_PROXY', 'HTTPS_PROXY', 'http_proxy', 'https_proxy'
1107	            $saved = @{}
1108	            if ($httpProxy) {
1109	                foreach ($v in $proxyVars) { $saved[$v] = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($v); Set-Item "env:$v" $httpProxy }
1110	            }
1111	            try {
1112	                $spArgs = @{
1113	                    FilePath                = $launch.Exe
1114	                    ArgumentList            = $argList
1115	                    PassThru                = $true
1116	                    WindowStyle             = 'Hidden'
1117	                    RedirectStandardOutput  = $logf
1118	                    RedirectStandardError   = "$logf.err"
1119	                }
1120	                if ($launch.Cwd) { $spArgs.WorkingDirectory = $launch.Cwd }
1121	                $p = Start-Process @spArgs
1122	            } finally {
1123	                if ($httpProxy) {
1124	                    foreach ($v in $proxyVars) {
1125	                        if ($null -eq $saved[$v]) { Remove-Item "env:$v" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
1126	                        else { Set-Item "env:$v" $saved[$v] }
1127	                    }
1128	                }
1129	            }
1130	            $p.Id | Set-Content -Path $pidf
1131	            $startTimeout = if ($env:COPILOT_PROXY_START_TIMEOUT) { [int]$env:COPILOT_PROXY_START_TIMEOUT } else { 45 }
1132	            for ($i = 0; $i -lt $startTimeout; $i++) {
1133	                if (Test-CopilotAlive) {
1134	                    if (Get-CopilotShimEnabled) {
1135	                        if (Start-CopilotShim) { Write-Host "copilot-proxy: throttle shim up -> $(Get-CopilotShimBase) (-> $(Get-CopilotBase))" }
1136	                    }
1137	                    Write-Host "copilot-proxy: up -> $(Get-CopilotClientBase)  (logs: copilot-proxy logs)"
1138	                    return
1139	                }
1140	                # Crashed on its own (bad flag, port taken, auth) — don't sit out the
1141	                # remaining seconds pretending we're still waiting.
1142	                if ($p.HasExited) {
1143	                    Remove-Item $pidf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
1144	                    Write-Error "copilot-proxy: server exited during startup — check 'copilot-proxy logs'."; return
1145	                }
1146	                Start-Sleep 1
1147	            }
1148	            # Timed out. REAP what we spawned: the old code returned and left it
1149	            # running, so each retry stacked another orphan and none ever bound the port.
1150	            Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
1151	            Remove-Item $pidf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
1152	            Write-Error "copilot-proxy: did not come up in time — check 'copilot-proxy logs'."
1153	        }
1154	        'stop' {
1155	            Stop-CopilotShim
1156	            if (Test-Path $pidf) {
1157	                $pid_ = Get-Content -First 1 $pidf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
1158	                if ($pid_) { Stop-Process -Id $pid_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
1159	                Remove-Item $pidf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
1160	            }
1161	            Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
1162	                Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like "*copilot-api*--port $port*" } |
1163	                ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
1164	            Start-Sleep 1
1165	            if (Test-CopilotAlive) { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: still answering on $port (another instance?)"; return }
1166	            Write-Host "copilot-proxy: stopped (port $port free)"
1167	        }
1168	        'restart' { copilot-proxy stop; copilot-proxy start }
1169	        'status' {
1170	            if (Test-CopilotAlive) {
1171	                $catalog = Get-CopilotModelCatalog
1172	                $rawIds = Get-CopilotCatalogIds $catalog
1173	                $claude = @($rawIds | Where-Object { $_ -like 'claude-*' })
1174	                $claudeText = if ($claude.Count -gt 0) { $claude -join ' ' } else { 'none' }
1175	                Write-Host "copilot-proxy: RUNNING on $(Get-CopilotBase)"
1176	                Write-Host "  models: $($rawIds.Count) served; Claude: $claudeText"
1177	                if (Get-CopilotShimEnabled) {
1178	                    if (Test-CopilotShimAlive) { Write-Host "  shim:   ON, up on $(Get-CopilotShimBase)  -> clients use this" }
1179	                    else { Write-Host "  shim:   ON but DOWN (clients fall back to $(Get-CopilotBase))" }
1180	                } else { Write-Host "  shim:   off  (enable: copilot-proxy shim on)" }
1181	            } else {
1182	                Write-Host "copilot-proxy: not running on port $port  (start: copilot-proxy start)"
1183	            }
1184	        }
1185	        { $_ -in 'doctor', 'test' } { Invoke-CopilotDoctor -Live:($Argv -contains '--live') }
1186	        'logs' {
1187	            if ($Argv.Count -ge 2 -and $Argv[1] -eq 'shim') {
1188	                $lf = Get-CopilotShimLog; $n = if ($Argv.Count -ge 3) { [int]$Argv[2] } else { 40 }
1189	            } else {
1190	                $lf = $logf; $n = if ($Argv.Count -ge 2) { [int]$Argv[1] } else { 40 }
1191	                if ($Argv.Count -ge 3 -and $Argv[2] -in '1', '2', '3') { $lf = "$logf.$($Argv[2])" }
1192	            }
1193	            if (Test-Path $lf) { Get-Content -Tail $n $lf }
1194	            elseif (Test-Path "$lf.err") { Get-Content -Tail $n "$lf.err" }
1195	            else { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: no log file at $lf" }
1196	        }
1197	        'auth' {
1198	            # One-time device login -> stores a ghu_ token copilot-api can exchange.
1199	            Write-Host "copilot-proxy: launching copilot-api device login ..."
1200	            if ((Get-CopilotPkgFlavor) -eq 'original') { Invoke-CopilotPkgCommand auth }
1201	            else { Invoke-CopilotPkgCommand auth login --provider copilot }
1202	        }
1203	        'reinstall' {
1204	            # Force a clean re-install of the pinned spec (normally only needed if the
1205	            # prefix got corrupted — a version bump re-installs on its own via the stamp).
1206	            Write-Host "copilot-proxy: removing $(Get-CopilotPkgPrefix) ..."
1207	            Remove-Item -Recurse -Force (Get-CopilotPkgPrefix) -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
1208	            if (-not (Install-CopilotPkg)) { return }
1209	            $installed = Get-CopilotPkgMetadata
1210	            Write-Host "copilot-proxy: installed $($installed.Name)@$($installed.Version) (requested $(Get-CopilotPkg)) -> $(Get-CopilotPkgPrefix)"
1211	        }
1212	        { $_ -in 'whoami', 'usage' } {
1213	            if (-not (Test-Path (Get-CopilotToken))) { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: not authenticated — run 'copilot-proxy auth'."; return }
1214	            if ((Get-CopilotPkgFlavor) -eq 'original') {
1215	                Invoke-CopilotPkgCommand check-usage
1216	            }
1217	            elseif (Test-CopilotAlive) {
1218	                try {
1219	                    $u = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$(Get-CopilotBase)/usage" -TimeoutSec 5 -ErrorAction Stop
1220	                    [pscustomobject]@{
1221	                        plan        = if ($u.copilot_plan) { $u.copilot_plan } elseif ($u.access_type_sku) { $u.access_type_sku } else { 'unknown' }
1222	                        quota_reset = $u.quota_reset_date
1223	                        quotas      = $u.quota_snapshots
1224	                    } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6
1225	                } catch { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: /usage query failed: $_" }
1226	            } else {
1227	                Write-Host "copilot-proxy: not running — showing auth/debug info instead of quota."
1228	                Invoke-CopilotPkgCommand debug
1229	            }
1230	        }
1231	        'shim' {
1232	            $sf = Get-CopilotShimState
1233	            $sub = if ($Argv.Count -ge 2) { $Argv[1] } else { 'status' }
1234	            switch ($sub) {
1235	                'on' {
1236	                    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Split-Path $sf) | Out-Null
1237	                    'on' | Set-Content $sf
1238	                    if (Test-CopilotAlive) { if (Start-CopilotShim) { Write-Host "copilot-proxy: shim ON -> $(Get-CopilotShimBase) (-> $(Get-CopilotBase))" } }
1239	                    else { Write-Host "copilot-proxy: shim enabled; will start with the proxy." }
1240	                    Write-Host "  NOTE: restart Claude Code so it picks up ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=$(Get-CopilotShimBase)"
1241	                }
1242	                'off' {
1243	                    'off' | Set-Content $sf; Stop-CopilotShim
1244	                    Write-Host "copilot-proxy: shim OFF (clients use $(Get-CopilotBase) directly)"
1245	                }
1246	                default {
1247	                    if (Get-CopilotShimEnabled) {
1248	                        $st = if (Test-CopilotShimAlive) { 'up' } else { 'down' }
1249	                        Write-Host "copilot-proxy: shim ON ($st) on $(Get-CopilotShimBase)"
1250	                    } else { Write-Host "copilot-proxy: shim off" }
1251	                }
1252	            }
1253	        }
1254	        { $_ -in '-h', '--help', 'help' } {
1255	            Write-Host "Usage: copilot-proxy [start|stop|restart|status|doctor [--live]|logs [shim|N [gen]]|shim [on|off|status]|whoami|auth|reinstall]"
1256	            Write-Host "  doctor (alias: test)  diagnose prereqs, package, auth, proxy, Claude catalog, Codex Apps"
1257	            Write-Host "                        (direct vs via proxy), upstream. --live costs 1 quota unit."
1258	            Write-Host "  COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY    auto|always|never|http://127.0.0.1:PORT  (default auto)"
1259	            Write-Host "                        auto attaches --proxy-env when a System/env proxy is found."
1260	            Write-Host "  reinstall             wipe + re-install the pinned package (a version bump"
1261	            Write-Host "                        re-installs on its own; this is for a corrupted prefix)."
1262	        }
1263	        default { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: unknown action '$action' (try --help)" }
1264	    }
1265	}
1266	
1267	# ------------------------------------------------------------------ doctor ----
1268	function script:Invoke-CopilotDoctor {
1269	    param([switch] $Live)
1270	    $port = Get-CopilotPort; $pkg = Get-CopilotPkg
1271	    $fail = 0; $warn = 0
1272	    function OK   ($n, $m) { Write-Host ("  " + [char]0x2713 + " {0,-16} {1}" -f $n, $m) -ForegroundColor Green }

1719-# --- specstory `-c` passthrough (why the base command must come from config) ---
1720-#
1721-# specstory's `-c/--command` REPLACES the provider's configured command — it does
1722-# NOT append to it. The shipped config says as much: "Use of these is equivalent
1723-# to -c \"custom command\"" — same slot, last write wins. So a hardcoded
1724-# `-c "claude $args"` silently drops every flag in `claude_cmd` the moment
1725-# claude-copilot has args to pass through, which made these two disagree:
1726-#
1727-#   claude-copilot-once             -> bypass-permissions  (no -c branch)
1728-#   claude-copilot-once --resume X  -> ~/.claude defaultMode "auto"
1729-#
1730-# Deriving the base command from the config keeps specstory the single source of
1731:# truth for BOTH branches. `--no-specstory` deliberately does NOT inherit it.
1732-
1733-# Effective `claude_cmd`, honouring specstory's own precedence:
1734-#   project ./.specstory/cli/config.toml > user ~/.specstory/cli/config.toml > `claude`
1735-# Matches UNCOMMENTED assignments only — both shipped configs carry a commented
1736-# `# claude_cmd = "claude"` example, and matching that would re-introduce the very
1737-# bug this exists to fix. Handles TOML's double- and single-quoted strings.
1738:function script:Get-SpecstoryClaudeCmd {
1739-    foreach ($f in '.specstory/cli/config.toml', (Join-Path $HOME '.specstory/cli/config.toml')) {
1740-        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f)) { continue }
1741-        foreach ($line in (Get-Content -LiteralPath $f -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
1742-            if ($line -match '^\s*claude_cmd\s*=\s*(?:"([^"]*)"|''([^'']*)'')') {
1743-                $v = if ($Matches[1]) { $Matches[1] } else { $Matches[2] }
1744-                if ($v) { return $v }
1745-            }
1746-        }
1747-    }
1748-    'claude'
1749-}
1750-
1751-# Single-quote ONE argument for embedding in specstory's `-c` command STRING.
1752-# specstory shell-splits that string honouring quotes, so quoting is both possible
1753-# and necessary — an unquoted join flattens `-p "two words"` into two arguments.
1754-# POSIX escape for an embedded quote: close, \', reopen.
1755:function script:ConvertTo-CopilotShQuote {
1756-    param([string] $Value)
1757-    "'" + ($Value -replace "'", "'\''") + "'"
1758-}

```text
129-(`Invoke-RestMethod`, `Start-Process`, `ConvertFrom-Json`) rather than shelling out
130-to the original bash. Only the Bun throttle shim (pure JS) is reused verbatim. See
131-[copilot-proxy](copilot-proxy.md).
132-
133:## `run_onchange` pwsh mergers for JSON config, not `modify_` scripts
134-
135:Some JSON config surfaces are **owned by the tool at runtime** — Claude Code
136-rewrites `~/.claude/settings.json` (plugins it installs, permissions you grant),
137-VSCode/Cursor rewrite their `settings.json`. Deploying a static managed copy
138:would clobber that live state, so these are **merged**, not overwritten. The
139:macOS/Linux repo merges with a chezmoi **`modify_` script** (a `sh` + `jq`
140:filter: read the live file on stdin, emit the merged result on stdout). On
141-Windows that doesn't hold up:
142-
143-- **Interpreter routing is by the *target's* extension.** chezmoi chooses a
144-  `modify_`/`create_` script's interpreter from the managed file's extension via
145-  `[interpreters.<ext>]`. `modify_settings.json` targets `settings.json` →
146-  `.json`, which maps to no interpreter. On Unix chezmoi falls back to the
147-  script's shebang (`#!/bin/sh`) + exec bit; Windows honors neither, so it can't
148-  run the script reliably — and you can't hand it a `.ps1` extension, because
149-  that's fixed to the target name. Only `[interpreters.ps1] = pwsh` is wired up,
150-  and it only helps when the *managed file itself* is a `.ps1`.
151-- **Wrong toolchain.** The parent filter is `sh` + `jq` — not guaranteed on a
152-  pwsh-first box, and rewriting it in pwsh still hits the routing wall above.
153-
154:So each merge is a **`run_onchange_after_*.ps1.tmpl`** in `.chezmoiscripts/`
155-instead: a real `.ps1` that routes cleanly through `[interpreters.ps1] = pwsh`,
156:runs natively with no external deps, and recursively deep-merges a
157:chezmoi-ignored overlay (`editors/*.json`, `claude/settings-overlay.json`,
158-embedded via `{{ include }}`) into the live file — preserving every key the tool
159-wrote. This is invariant #5 in `AGENTS.md`.
160-
161-**Tradeoff:** a `modify_` filter re-asserts on *every* apply; `run_onchange` only
162:re-fires when its rendered content (the overlay) changes. If the tool later
163:overwrites a managed key, it isn't restored until the overlay changes or you
164-reset state (`chezmoi state delete-bucket --bucket=entryState`). The parent needs
165-every-apply enforcement because CodeIsland / workmux keep rewriting
166-`~/.claude/settings.json`; Windows has no such contenders, so the lighter trigger
167-is fine.
168-
169-## XDG paths, not `%APPDATA%`
170-
171-Windows and XDG split directories on different axes — Windows by whether a
172-folder *roams* (`AppData\Roaming` vs `AppData\Local`), XDG by *purpose*
```

112:## JSON 設定用 `run_onchange` pwsh 合併器，而非 `modify_` 腳本
113-
114:有些 JSON 設定面是**由工具在執行期擁有**的 —— Claude Code 會改寫
115-`~/.claude/settings.json`（它安裝的外掛、你授予的權限），VSCode/Cursor 會改寫各自的
116:`settings.json`。直接部署一份靜態受管副本會蓋掉這些即時狀態，所以它們是用**合併**、
117:而非覆寫。macOS/Linux repo 用 chezmoi 的 **`modify_` 腳本**來合併（一個 `sh` + `jq`
118:過濾器：從 stdin 讀入 live 檔，把合併結果吐到 stdout）。在 Windows 上這行不通：
119-
120-- **直譯器是用「目標檔」的副檔名決定的。** chezmoi 依受管檔的副檔名從
121-  `[interpreters.<ext>]` 選 `modify_`/`create_` 腳本的直譯器。`modify_settings.json`
122-  的目標是 `settings.json` → `.json`，查不到任何直譯器。Unix 上 chezmoi 會退回用腳本的
123-  shebang（`#!/bin/sh`）+ 執行位元；Windows 兩者都不吃，所以無法可靠執行 —— 而且你
124-  沒辦法給它 `.ps1` 副檔名，因為那綁死在目標名上。這裡只接了
125-  `[interpreters.ps1] = pwsh`，而它只有在「受管檔本身就是 `.ps1`」時才幫得上忙。
126-- **工具鏈不對。** 父 repo 的過濾器是 `sh` + `jq` —— 在 pwsh 為主的機器上不保證存在，
127-  就算改寫成 pwsh 也還是撞上上面的路由問題。
128-
129:所以每個合併改成放在 `.chezmoiscripts/` 的 **`run_onchange_after_*.ps1.tmpl`**：一個
130-真正的 `.ps1`，乾淨地走 `[interpreters.ps1] = pwsh`、原生執行、零外部依賴，並把一份
131:chezmoi 忽略的 overlay（`editors/*.json`、`claude/settings-overlay.json`，經
132:`{{ include }}` 內嵌）遞迴深度合併進 live 檔 —— 保留工具寫入的每個 key。這就是
133-`AGENTS.md` 的 invariant #5。
134-
135-**取捨：** `modify_` 過濾器每次 apply 都會重新套用；`run_onchange` 只在其 render 後
136:內容（即 overlay）改變時才重跑。若工具之後覆蓋了某個受管 key，它不會被還原，直到
137:overlay 改變或你重置狀態（`chezmoi state delete-bucket --bucket=entryState`）。父 repo
138-需要每次 apply 都強制，是因為 CodeIsland / workmux 會一直改寫
139-`~/.claude/settings.json`；Windows 沒有這種對手，所以較輕的觸發就夠了。

141-## XDG 路徑，而非 `%APPDATA%`
142-
143-Windows 與 XDG 用不同的軸切目錄 —— Windows 看資料夾是否*漫遊*
144-（`AppData\Roaming` vs `AppData\Local`），XDG 看*用途*（config / data / state /
145-cache）—— 所以 `%APPDATA%` 並不是乾淨的「Windows 版 XDG」。與其硬對應，
146-`profile.d/00_env.ps1` 直接把 `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` 等設成 Unix 風格的

44-apply`. Run `copilot-model --auto` once after this upgrade. When `copilot-here`

46-global one-line main-model state.

177-  `copilot-model --auto`, and shim toggles cannot repair that account setting.

179-  committed project settings. `off` removes every env key owned by the helper and
180-  preserves unrelated settings.
181:- `claude-copilot` and `claude-copilot-once` retain the Windows port's trusted
182:  `--dangerously-skip-permissions` and optional SpecStory behavior. Plain `claude`
183-  is unaffected.
184-- The throttle shim remains byte-identical to the macOS/Linux copy and retries
185-  transient 403/429 bursts while limiting concurrent requests. It deliberately
186-  passes HTTP 402 through once; billing configuration is not a throttle failure.
187-
188-State lives under `~/.local/state/copilot-proxy/`; device login stores the GitHub

209-`content-encoding` header.

214:SpecStory is automatic when installed. The wrapper preserves the effective
215-`codex_cmd` (project config > user config > bare `codex`) before appending

217-Gemini fallback through Responses Lite, which does not support Responses

379	function validatePathLevels(value: unknown): value is PathLevels {
380	  return value === 1 || value === 2 || value === 3 || value === 'full';
381	}

383	function validateLineLayout(value: unknown): value is LineLayoutType {
384	  return value === 'compact' || value === 'expanded';
385	}

388	  return value === 'enabled' || value === 'disabled';

392	  return value === 'truncate' || value === 'wrap';
393	}
394	
395	function validateContextValue(value: unknown): value is ContextValueMode {
396	  return value === 'percent' || value === 'tokens' || value === 'remaining' || value === 'both';
397	}
398	
399	function validateUsageValue(value: unknown): value is UsageValueMode {
400	  return value === 'percent' || value === 'remaining';
401	}
402	
403	function validateLanguage(value: unknown): value is Language {
404	  return value === 'en' || value === 'zh' || value === 'zh-Hans' || value === 'zh-Hant' || value === 'zh-TW';
405	}

407	function validateModelFormat(value: unknown): value is ModelFormatMode {
408	  return value === 'full' || value === 'compact' || value === 'short';

412	  return value === 'relative'
413	    || value === 'absolute'
414	    || value === 'both'
415	    || value === 'elapsed'
416	    || value === 'elapsedAndAbsolute';

420	  return value === 'first' || value === 'last';

424	  return value === 'auto' || value === 'h11' || value === 'h12' || value === 'h23' || value === 'h24';

427	function validateColorName(value: unknown): value is HudColorName {
428	  return value === 'dim'
429	    || value === 'red'
430	    || value === 'green'
431	    || value === 'yellow'
432	    || value === 'magenta'
433	    || value === 'cyan'
434	    || value === 'brightBlue'
435	    || value === 'brightMagenta';

438	const UNSAFE_CODEPOINT = /[\p{Cc}\p{Cf}\p{Variation_Selector}\p{Zl}\p{Zp}\p{Cn}]/u;
439	
440	function validateBarChar(value: unknown): value is string {
441	  if (typeof value !== 'string' || value.length === 0) return false;
442	
443	  const segmenter = new Intl.Segmenter(undefined, { granularity: 'grapheme' });
444	  if (Array.from(segmenter.segment(value)).length !== 1) return false;
445	
446	  for (const ch of value) {
447	    if (UNSAFE_CODEPOINT.test(ch)) return false;
448	  }
449	  return true;
450	}
451	
452	const HEX_COLOR_PATTERN = /^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/;
453	
454	function validateColorValue(value: unknown): value is HudColorValue {
455	  if (validateColorName(value)) return true;
456	  if (typeof value === 'number' && Number.isInteger(value) && value >= 0 && value <= 255) return true;
457	  if (typeof value === 'string' && HEX_COLOR_PATTERN.test(value)) return true;
458	  return false;
459	}
460	
461	function validateElementOrder(value: unknown): HudElement[] {
462	  if (!Array.isArray(value) || value.length === 0) {
463	    return [...DEFAULT_ELEMENT_ORDER];
464	  }
465	
466	  const seen = new Set<HudElement>();
467	  const elementOrder: HudElement[] = [];
468	
469	  for (const item of value) {
470	    if (typeof item !== 'string' || !KNOWN_ELEMENTS.has(item as HudElement)) {
471	      continue;
472	    }
473	
474	    const element = item as HudElement;
475	    if (seen.has(element)) {
476	      continue;
477	    }
478	
479	    seen.add(element);
480	    elementOrder.push(element);
481	  }
482	
483	  return elementOrder.length > 0 ? elementOrder : [...DEFAULT_ELEMENT_ORDER];
484	}
485	
486	// Unlike `elementOrder`, `projectLineOrder` only reorders segments. A partial
487	// list is preserved as a requested prefix; each renderer appends all remaining
488	// visible parts in its own existing order.
489	function validateProjectLineOrder(value: unknown): FirstLineSegment[] {
490	  if (!Array.isArray(value)) {
491	    return [...DEFAULT_PROJECT_LINE_ORDER];
492	  }
493	
494	  const seen = new Set<FirstLineSegment>();
495	  const order: FirstLineSegment[] = [];
496	
497	  for (const item of value) {
498	    if (typeof item !== 'string' || !KNOWN_FIRST_LINE_SEGMENTS.has(item as FirstLineSegment)) {
499	      continue;
500	    }
501	
502	    const segment = item as FirstLineSegment;
503	    if (seen.has(segment)) {
504	      continue;
505	    }
506	
507	    seen.add(segment);
508	    order.push(segment);
509	  }
510	
511	  return order;
512	}
513	
514	function validateRightAlign(value: unknown): HudElement[] {
515	  if (!Array.isArray(value)) {
516	    return [...DEFAULT_CONFIG.display.rightAlign];
517	  }
518	
519	  const seen = new Set<HudElement>();
520	  const elements: HudElement[] = [];
521	
522	  for (const item of value) {
523	    if (typeof item !== 'string' || !KNOWN_ELEMENTS.has(item as HudElement)) {
524	      continue;
525	    }
526	
527	    const element = item as HudElement;
528	    if (seen.has(element)) {
529	      continue;
530	    }
531	
532	    seen.add(element);
533	    elements.push(element);
534	  }
535	
536	  return elements;
537	}
538	
539	function validateMergeGroups(value: unknown): HudElement[][] {
540	  if (!Array.isArray(value)) {
541	    return DEFAULT_MERGE_GROUPS.map(group => [...group]);
542	  }
543	
544	  if (value.length === 0) {
545	    return [];
546	  }
547	
548	  const usedElements = new Set<HudElement>();
549	  const mergeGroups: HudElement[][] = [];
550	
551	  for (const group of value) {
552	    if (!Array.isArray(group)) {
553	      continue;
554	    }
555	
556	    const seenInGroup = new Set<HudElement>();
557	    const normalizedGroup: HudElement[] = [];
558	    const pendingElements: HudElement[] = [];
559	
560	    for (const item of group) {
561	      if (typeof item !== 'string' || !KNOWN_ELEMENTS.has(item as HudElement)) {
562	        continue;
563	      }
564	
565	      const element = item as HudElement;
566	      if (seenInGroup.has(element) || usedElements.has(element)) {
567	        continue;
568	      }
569	
570	      seenInGroup.add(element);
571	      normalizedGroup.push(element);
572	      pendingElements.push(element);
573	    }
574	
575	    if (normalizedGroup.length >= 2) {
576	      for (const element of pendingElements) {
577	        usedElements.add(element);
578	      }
579	      mergeGroups.push(normalizedGroup);
580	    }
581	  }
582	
583	  return mergeGroups.length > 0
584	    ? mergeGroups
585	    : DEFAULT_MERGE_GROUPS.map(group => [...group]);
586	}

588	interface LegacyConfig {
589	  layout?: 'default' | 'separators' | Record<string, unknown>;
590	}
591	
592	function migrateConfig(userConfig: Partial<HudConfig> & LegacyConfig): Partial<HudConfig> {
593	  const migrated = { ...userConfig } as Partial<HudConfig> & LegacyConfig;
594	
595	  if ('layout' in userConfig && !('lineLayout' in userConfig)) {
596	    if (typeof userConfig.layout === 'string') {
597	      // Legacy string migration (v0.0.x → v0.1.x)
598	      if (userConfig.layout === 'separators') {
599	        migrated.lineLayout = 'compact';
600	        migrated.showSeparators = true;
601	      } else {
602	        migrated.lineLayout = 'compact';
603	        migrated.showSeparators = false;
604	      }
605	    } else if (typeof userConfig.layout === 'object' && userConfig.layout !== null) {
606	      // Object layout written by third-party tools — extract nested fields
607	      const obj = userConfig.layout as Record<string, unknown>;
608	      if (typeof obj.lineLayout === 'string') migrated.lineLayout = obj.lineLayout as any;
609	      if (typeof obj.showSeparators === 'boolean') migrated.showSeparators = obj.showSeparators;
610	      if (typeof obj.pathLevels === 'number' || obj.pathLevels === 'full') migrated.pathLevels = obj.pathLevels as any;
611	    }
612	    delete migrated.layout;
613	  }
614	
615	  return migrated;
616	}

618	function validateThreshold(value: unknown, fallback: number): number {
619	  if (typeof value !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(value)) return fallback;
620	  return Math.max(0, Math.min(100, value));
621	}
622	
623	function validateContextThreshold(value: unknown, fallback: number): number {
624	  if (typeof value !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(value)) return fallback;
625	  return Math.max(0, Math.min(100, value));
626	}
627	
628	function validateCountThreshold(value: unknown): number {
629	  if (typeof value !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(value)) {
630	    return 0;
631	  }
632	  return Math.max(0, Math.floor(value));
633	}
634	
635	function validateDurationSeconds(value: unknown, fallback: number): number {
636	  if (typeof value !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(value) || value <= 0) {
637	    return fallback;
638	  }
639	  return Math.floor(value);
640	}
641	
642	function validateNonNegativeInteger(value: unknown, fallback: number): number {
643	  if (typeof value !== 'number' || !Number.isInteger(value) || value < 0) {
644	    return fallback;
645	  }
646	  return value;
647	}
648	
649	function validateAutoCompactWindow(value: unknown): number | null {
650	  if (typeof value !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(value) || !Number.isInteger(value) || value <= 0) {
651	    return null;
652	  }
653	  return value;
654	}
655	
656	function validateOptionalPath(value: unknown): string {
657	  return typeof value === 'string' ? value.trim() : '';
658	}
659	
660	function validateFreshnessMs(value: unknown): number {
661	  if (typeof value !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(value)) {
662	    return DEFAULT_CONFIG.display.externalUsageFreshnessMs;
663	  }
664	  return Math.max(0, Math.floor(value));
665	}

490	  return { claudeMdCount, rulesCount, mcpCount, hooksCount, outputStyle };
491	}

493	export async function countConfigs(cwd?: string): Promise<ConfigCounts> {
494	  const homeDir = os.homedir();
495	  const claudeDir = getClaudeConfigDir(homeDir);
496	  const claudeConfigJsonPath = getClaudeConfigJsonPath(homeDir);
497	  const normalizedCwd = cwd ? path.resolve(cwd) : null;
498	
499	  const staticSentinelPaths = buildSentinelPaths(claudeDir, claudeConfigJsonPath, normalizedCwd);
500	  const cached = readConfigCache({ cwd: normalizedCwd, claudeConfigDir: claudeDir }, homeDir);
501	  const cacheValidationPaths = cached
502	    ? Array.from(new Set([...staticSentinelPaths, ...Object.keys(cached.key.sentinels)]))
503	    : staticSentinelPaths;
504	  const currentSentinels = statSentinels(cacheValidationPaths);
505	
506	  if (cached && sentinelsMatch(cached.key.sentinels, currentSentinels)) {
507	    return cached.data;
508	  }
509	
510	  const result = computeConfigCountsFresh(cwd);
511	
512	  const ruleSentinelPaths = collectRuleDirectorySentinels(path.join(claudeDir, 'rules'));
513	  const projectClaudeDir = normalizedCwd ? path.join(normalizedCwd, '.claude') : null;
514	  const projectClaudeOverlapsUserScope = projectClaudeDir
515	    ? pathsReferToSameLocation(projectClaudeDir, claudeDir)
516	    : false;
517	  if (normalizedCwd && !projectClaudeOverlapsUserScope) {
518	    ruleSentinelPaths.push(...collectRuleDirectorySentinels(path.join(normalizedCwd, '.claude', 'rules')));
519	  }
520	
521	  const cacheSentinelPaths = Array.from(new Set([...staticSentinelPaths, ...ruleSentinelPaths]));
522	  const cacheKey: ConfigCacheKey = {
523	    cwd: normalizedCwd,
524	    claudeConfigDir: claudeDir,
525	    sentinels: statSentinels(cacheSentinelPaths),
526	  };
527	  writeConfigCache(cacheKey, result, homeDir);
528	  return result;
529	}

15	  if (!envConfigDir) {

17	  }
18	  return path.resolve(expandHomeDirPrefix(envConfigDir, homeDir));

1	#Requires -Version 7
2	# run_onchange_after_20_editor_overlays.ps1 — merge a shared settings overlay
3	# into VSCode + Cursor, and seed keybindings once. Re-runs when either embedded
4	# source file changes. Skips an editor whose User dir doesn't exist (not installed).
5	
6	$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'   # best-effort; never abort the apply
7	
8	# Embedded at render time from the (chezmoi-ignored) editors/ sources — so this
9	# script is self-contained and re-runs when they change.
10	$overlayJson = @'
11	{{ include "editors/vscode-overlay.json" }}
12	'@
13	$keybindingsJson = @'
14	{{ include "editors/keybindings.json" }}
15	'@
16	
17	$overlay = $overlayJson | ConvertFrom-Json -AsHashtable
18	
19	function Merge-EditorSettings([string]$userDir) {
20	    if (-not (Test-Path $userDir)) { return }   # editor not installed
21	    $settingsPath = Join-Path $userDir 'settings.json'
22	    $settings = @{}
23	    if (Test-Path $settingsPath) {
24	        $raw = Get-Content -Raw $settingsPath
25	        # best-effort JSONC: drop whole-line // comments and /* */ blocks.
26	        $raw = [regex]::Replace($raw, '(?m)^\s*//.*$', '')
27	        $raw = [regex]::Replace($raw, '/\*.*?\*/', '', 'Singleline')
28	        if ($raw.Trim()) { try { $settings = $raw | ConvertFrom-Json -AsHashtable } catch { Write-Warning "could not parse $settingsPath; overlaying onto empty"; $settings = @{} } }
29	    }
30	    foreach ($k in $overlay.Keys) { $settings[$k] = $overlay[$k] }
31	    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $userDir | Out-Null
32	    $settings | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 12 | Set-Content -Path $settingsPath -Encoding utf8
33	    Write-Host "editor overlay -> $settingsPath"
34	
35	    # Seed keybindings once; never clobber the user's edits.
36	    $kbPath = Join-Path $userDir 'keybindings.json'
37	    if (-not (Test-Path $kbPath)) {
38	        $keybindingsJson | Set-Content -Path $kbPath -Encoding utf8
39	        Write-Host "seeded keybindings -> $kbPath"
40	    }
41	}
42	
43	foreach ($editor in 'Code', 'Cursor') {
44	    Merge-EditorSettings (Join-Path $env:APPDATA "$editor\User")
45	}

1	#Requires -Version 7
2	# run_onchange_after_30_windows_terminal.ps1 — set Windows Terminal's shared
3	# profile defaults (font, color, opacity) without touching individual profiles.
4	# No-op if WT isn't installed / hasn't created its settings.json yet.
5	
6	$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'   # best-effort; never abort the apply
7	
8	$candidates = @()
9	$candidates += Get-ChildItem "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Packages\Microsoft.WindowsTerminal*\LocalState\settings.json" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object FullName
10	$candidates += "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Microsoft\Windows Terminal\settings.json"
11	$path = $candidates | Where-Object { Test-Path $_ } | Select-Object -First 1
12	
13	if (-not $path) { Write-Host 'Windows Terminal settings.json not found — launch WT once, then re-apply.'; return }
14	
15	$raw = Get-Content -Raw $path
16	
17	# Back up the pre-merge settings.json ONCE before we rewrite it. This merge is
18	# non-destructive (only profiles.defaults + defaultProfile change; your profile
19	# list / schemes / keybindings are preserved), but ConvertTo-Json reformats the
20	# file and strips comments, so keep an escape hatch. The run_once_before backup
21	# doesn't cover this package-versioned %LOCALAPPDATA% path.
22	$bak = Join-Path (Join-Path $HOME '.dotfiles-backup') 'windows-terminal-settings.json.bak'
23	if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $bak)) {
24	    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Split-Path $bak -Parent) | Out-Null
25	    Copy-Item -LiteralPath $path -Destination $bak -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
26	    Write-Host "backed up Windows Terminal settings -> $bak"
27	}
28	
29	$raw = [regex]::Replace($raw, '(?m)^\s*//.*$', '')   # drop whole-line comments
30	try { $s = $raw | ConvertFrom-Json -AsHashtable } catch { Write-Warning "could not parse $path — skipping"; return }
31	
32	if (-not $s.ContainsKey('profiles')) { $s['profiles'] = @{} }
33	if ($s.profiles -isnot [hashtable]) { $s['profiles'] = @{ list = $s.profiles } }
34	if (-not $s.profiles.ContainsKey('defaults')) { $s.profiles['defaults'] = @{} }
35	
36	$s.profiles.defaults['font'] = @{ face = 'Hack Nerd Font Mono'; size = 11 }
37	$s.profiles.defaults['colorScheme'] = 'One Half Dark'
38	$s.profiles.defaults['opacity'] = 90
39	$s.profiles.defaults['useAcrylic'] = $true
40	$s.profiles.defaults['cursorShape'] = 'filledBox'
41	$s.profiles.defaults['antialiasingMode'] = 'grayscale'
42	$s.profiles.defaults['padding'] = '8'
43	
44	# Prefer PowerShell 7 as the default profile when a matching profile exists.
45	if ($s.profiles.ContainsKey('list')) {
46	    $pwshProfile = @($s.profiles.list) |
47	        Where-Object { ($_.commandline -match 'pwsh') -or ($_.name -eq 'PowerShell') } |
48	        Select-Object -First 1
49	    if ($pwshProfile -and $pwshProfile.guid) { $s['defaultProfile'] = $pwshProfile.guid }
50	}
51	
52	# CSI-u key bindings so TUI agents (Claude Code, Codex, …) receive the same
53	# modified-key encodings WT otherwise can't distinguish from their unmodified
54	# forms. Full parity with the WezTerm (dot_config/wezterm/wezterm.lua) and
55	# Alacritty (AppData/Roaming/alacritty/alacritty.toml.tmpl) configs:
56	#   Shift+Enter -> ESC[13;2u   insert newline instead of submit (load-bearing)
57	#   Ctrl+Enter  -> ESC[13;5u
58	#   Ctrl+/      -> 0x1f (US)
59	#   Ctrl+0..9   -> ESC[<digit-ASCII>;5u   (Ctrl+1 -> ESC[49;5u … Ctrl+0 -> ESC[48;5u)
60	# Ctrl+0 overrides WT's default resetFontSize, exactly as the WezTerm/Alacritty
61	# configs already claim it. Non-destructive: append only bindings whose `keys`
62	# aren't already present, so a hand-added user binding always wins. The ESC
63	# ([char]27) / US ([char]31) are load-bearing — ConvertTo-Json serializes them to
64	# their JSON escape form (what sendInput wants); hand-typing tends to drop the
65	# escape (AGENTS.md invariant #3, re-parse-verified in the tests).
66	$esc = [char]27
67	$wantActions = @(
68	    @{ keys = 'shift+enter'; command = @{ action = 'sendInput'; input = "$esc[13;2u" } }
69	    @{ keys = 'ctrl+enter';  command = @{ action = 'sendInput'; input = "$esc[13;5u" } }
70	    @{ keys = 'ctrl+/';      command = @{ action = 'sendInput'; input = "$([char]31)" } }
71	)
72	# Ctrl+0..9 -> ESC[<ASCII>;5u, ASCII = 48 + digit (matches string.byte in the
73	# WezTerm loop). Built with -f to sidestep string-index ambiguity on "$esc[".
74	foreach ($d in 0..9) {
75	    $wantActions += @{ keys = "ctrl+$d"; command = @{ action = 'sendInput'; input = ('{0}[{1};5u' -f $esc, (48 + $d)) } }
76	}
77	$actions = @()
78	if ($s.ContainsKey('actions')) { $actions = @($s['actions']) }
79	# NB: read the 'keys' FIELD as $_['keys']; $_.keys returns the hashtable's own
80	# .Keys collection (the -AsHashtable gotcha), not the JSON value 'shift+enter'.
81	$existingKeys = @($actions | ForEach-Object { $_['keys'] })
82	foreach ($b in $wantActions) {
83	    if ($b['keys'] -notin $existingKeys) { $actions += $b }
84	}
85	$s['actions'] = $actions
86	
87	$s | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20 | Set-Content -Path $path -Encoding utf8
88	Write-Host "Windows Terminal defaults updated -> $path"
89

# agent-history-hygiene

Keep agent chat transcripts and plan files committed together with the
code they produced, without leaking secrets. Pairs with the
`redact-agent-secrets` + `gitleaks` pre-commit hooks the skill installs.

Three surfaces, separated by purpose:

| Surface                          | Question it answers                                          |
|----------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------|
| `find-session.sh`                | "Which transcript / plan file is *my* current session?"      |
| `stage-agent-artifacts.sh`       | "Which agent files belong in the next commit?"               |
| `bootstrap-project.sh`           | "How do I get pre-commit + gitleaks + redactor into a repo?" |
| `scan-staged.sh`                 | "Is there a leaked secret in what I'm about to commit?"      |
| `references/remediation.md`      | "I already pushed a secret — now what?"                      |

## Core invariants

1. **Agent transcripts and plan files are committed alongside the diff
   that produced them.** Never add them to `.gitignore`. An agent that
   drops these from a commit has broken the user's review trail.
2. **Rotate at the provider before any git rewrite.** The only act
   that revokes a leaked credential is rotation. History rewriting
   scrubs bytes on one clone and leaves them on every other.
3. **`git push --force` against a shared branch is never the fix for a
   leak.** At best it's useless; at worst it destroys teammate work and
   silently re-introduces the secret when someone merges their old
   history back.

## When to use this skill

Use it when the user (or you) surface any of:

- "Commit my chat" / "save the specstory session" / "include the plan
  file in this commit" / "把 plan 跟 specstory 一起 commit 進去".
- You see dirty `.specstory/history/*.md`, `.claude/plans/*.md`,
  `.cursor/plans/*.md`, or any other configured agent artifact during
  `git status` and you're about to commit a feature.
- "Scrub this transcript" / "redact my key" / "gitleaks flagged my
  chat history".
- "Set up pre-commit for this repo" / "I'm starting a new project — how
  do I get the hook stack?" / "bootstrap secret scanning here".
- "I pushed a `.env`" / "a secret went to main" / "do I need to force
  push?" — the agent must steer to `references/remediation.md` and
  stop the user from force-pushing reflexively.

## When NOT to use

- The user explicitly wants agent transcripts **excluded** from the
  repo. Respect that; suggest a one-liner `.gitignore` addition and
  skip this skill entirely.
- The leak is already on a shared `main`/release branch. Do **not**
  offer to rewrite history — jump to `references/remediation.md` §5.
- The project genuinely has no agent session (no `.specstory/`, no
  `.claude/plans/`, etc.). Nothing to stage.
- Single-file, single-commit hygiene that the agent handles without any
  script (e.g., adding a missing trailing newline).

## Integration with existing infrastructure

This skill sits **on top of** any chezmoi-managed stack the user
already has. It does not duplicate:

- **chezmoi's global `core.hooksPath`** (`~/.config/git/hooks/pre-commit`)
  — that wrapper runs the repo's `.pre-commit-config.yaml` and then
  optionally `gitleaks git --staged`. The skill bootstraps the repo-level
  config the wrapper expects to find.
- **chezmoi's `.gitleaks.toml`** — the user's config already carries
  curated rules for common API keys (OpenAI, Anthropic, Supabase,
  Linear, WakaTime, Cursor, HuggingFace, Notion, Tailscale, Clash /
  V2Ray tokens). The skill's `assets/gitleaks.toml.template` ships the
  same rule IDs so `.gitleaksignore` / allowlist tweaks stay portable.
- **chezmoi's `scripts/redact_secrets.py`** — remains the upstream
  source of truth. The skill bundles a copy so non-chezmoi users get
  protection; sync procedure in
  [`references/pre-commit-redaction-stack.md`](references/pre-commit-redaction-stack.md).

What this skill **adds**:

- Agent-facing discipline (this `SKILL.md` + `references/remediation.md`).
- A single-command project bootstrap (`bootstrap-project.sh`) for repos
  without chezmoi or where the user wants the stack in one go.
- Session-discovery heuristics (`find-session.sh`) for the "find my
  current transcript among many" problem.
- An exit-code wrapper (`scan-staged.sh`) agents can branch on before
  committing.

## Workflow A: commit-time hygiene

Default flow when the agent is about to commit feature changes plus
chat/plan artifacts.

```bash
# 1. Make sure the agent knows which session is "ours" — mostly
#    relevant when multiple Claude/SpecStory sessions run in the repo.
bash skills/local/agent-history-hygiene/scripts/find-session.sh

# 2. Stage code the usual way, then auto-add agent artifacts.
git add path/to/feature/file.ts
bash skills/local/agent-history-hygiene/scripts/stage-agent-artifacts.sh
# Use --session-only if you want ONLY the current SpecStory + newest plan;
# default stages every dirty *.md in every configured agent dir.

# 3. Belt-and-suspenders secret scan before commit. Exit 0 = clean.
bash skills/local/agent-history-hygiene/scripts/scan-staged.sh || {
  # Exit 10/20: leaks found. Jump to references/remediation.md.
  echo "Leaks detected — see references/remediation.md before committing." >&2
  exit 1
}

# 4. Commit. pre-commit (installed by bootstrap) runs redact-agent-secrets
#    then gitleaks again as a catch-all.
git commit -m "feat: ..."
```

## Workflow B: bootstrap a new project

For repos that don't yet have `.pre-commit-config.yaml` / `.gitleaks.toml`
installed. Runs once per repo.

```bash
cd /path/to/new/project
bash skills/local/agent-history-hygiene/scripts/bootstrap-project.sh \
  --install-hook            # optional: auto-stage on every commit

# Verify: shake out any existing issues in the working tree.
pre-commit run --all-files
```

What `bootstrap-project.sh` does:

1. Drops `.pre-commit-config.yaml` + `.gitleaks.toml` into the repo
   (skips if already present unless `--force`).
2. Writes `scripts/redact_secrets.py` (bundled copy; use
   `--from-chezmoi` to symlink the chezmoi source so fixes propagate).
3. Runs `pre-commit install` (or `uvx pre-commit@4 install` if
   pre-commit isn't on `PATH`).
4. Audits `.gitignore` / `.git/info/exclude` for patterns that would
   silently hide an agent artifact dir — warns without editing.
5. Checks `~/.claude/settings.json` for `plansDirectory`; prints the
   one-line patch if missing.
6. With `--install-hook`: writes a `prepare-commit-msg` hook that calls
   `stage-agent-artifacts.sh --session-only --allow-empty` so every
   `git commit` auto-attaches the current session file.

## Workflow C: post-leak remediation

When `scan-staged.sh` reports exit `10`/`20`, or the user says "I
committed / pushed a secret":

1. **STOP** the user from running `git push --force` reflexively.
2. Read `references/remediation.md` end-to-end.
3. Walk the user through **step 1 (rotate)** regardless of blast
   radius. Only after rotation does the question of scrubbing history
   become worth discussing.
4. Use the decision tree in the runbook to pick the right git action.

## Gotchas

- **`plansDirectory` project-level sometimes ignored.** Claude Code
  issue [#19537](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/19537)
  reports project-level `plansDirectory` being ignored in some
  versions. After running a `/plan`, verify the file actually landed
  where you expected before relying on `stage-agent-artifacts.sh`
  picking it up. User-level config (`~/.claude/settings.json` with
  `"plansDirectory": "./.claude/plans"`) is the recommended default.
- **`gitleaks protect` is deprecated.** Since v8.19.0 use
  `gitleaks git --staged --redact` (pre-commit) and
  `gitleaks dir <path>` (working directory). The older commands still
  work but emit a deprecation notice. This skill uses the modern
  syntax everywhere.
- **`pre-commit install` is per-clone.** Each teammate must run
  `pre-commit install` in their own clone for hooks to fire. CI cannot
  be trusted as the single gate — it's second-chance, not last-chance.
- **Transcript files can be huge.** A long SpecStory session can exceed
  2 MB. The template bumps `check-added-large-files` to `--maxkb=2048`
  to avoid false positives, but a very long session can still overflow.
  If you hit the limit, rotate sessions (`specstory run claude`
  creates a fresh file) instead of raising the cap further.
- **Session-UUID divergence between SpecStory CLI and VS Code
  extension.** The extension autosaves into `.specstory/history/`
  continuously; the CLI (`specstory run claude`) creates one file per
  invocation. If both are active you can end up with two transcripts
  for what feels like "one session" — mtime-newest wins in
  `find-session.sh`.
- **Global `core.hooksPath` means bare repos aren't protected.** The
  chezmoi setup's global hook runs `.pre-commit-config.yaml` IF it
  exists — so a repo without `.pre-commit-config.yaml` has no
  protection. Run `bootstrap-project.sh` before the first commit with
  agent artifacts, not after.
- **Active SpecStory writer can defeat the redact loop.** The standard
  `git add → git commit → pre-commit auto-fixes → re-stage → re-commit`
  flow assumes the file is **quiescent** during the commit. SpecStory's
  `specstory_*_watch` daemon tails the agent transcript continuously,
  so if the chat captured `ps -axo args`-style output that contained an
  unrelated daemon's secret in argv (e.g. SpecStory's own
  `--cloud-token …` flag), every diagnostic command (`grep`, `sed -n
  '<line>p'`, `cat | head | tail`) prints the secret again, SpecStory
  appends it to the transcript, and the redact-then-restage cycle
  never converges. Symptom: pre-commit says "Successfully redacted N
  file(s)" but `gitleaks-system` immediately fails on the same line,
  re-running `git add && git commit` doesn't help, and `grep -c
  '<secret-prefix>' file` shows the count *increasing* over commit
  attempts. **Workaround**: a single atomic
  `python3 -c "<in-place re.sub>" && git add <file> && git commit -m
  "..."` pipeline so the index is frozen before any new specstory write
  lands. **Don't** print, grep, or diff the secret line during the
  recovery — every print echoes back into the transcript. Diagnose with
  `lsof <file>` (looking for `specstory_*` writers) instead. See
  `pitfalls/redact-secrets-loop-with-active-specstory-writer.md` in
  upstream chezmoi for the full debugging trail.

## Available scripts

- **`scripts/find-session.sh [--format=specstory|claude|both] [--json]`**
  Discover the current agent session files for `$PWD`. TSV default,
  `--json` for structured callers. Never exits non-zero (always 0,
  empty fields signal absence).

- **`scripts/stage-agent-artifacts.sh [--session-only] [--include-all-plans] [--dry-run] [--allow-empty]`**
  `git add` the right agent artifacts before the next commit.
  `--session-only` stages only the current SpecStory + newest plan;
  default stages every dirty `*.md` in every configured artifact dir.
  Refuses to run if there are no code changes (prevents "commit just
  transcript"); override with `--allow-empty`.

- **`scripts/scan-staged.sh [--redact] [--verbose]`**
  Run `gitleaks git --staged` with agent-friendly exit codes
  (0 clean / 10 redacted / 20 leaks / 30 gitleaks missing). JSON lines
  on stdout, prose diagnostics on stderr.

- **`scripts/bootstrap-project.sh [--from-chezmoi] [--install-hook] [--force] [--dry-run]`**
  Install `.pre-commit-config.yaml` + `.gitleaks.toml` + the redactor
  into the current repo, then run `pre-commit install`. Audits
  `.gitignore` and `~/.claude/settings.json` for misconfigurations
  (warns, never silently edits).

## Bundled assets

- `assets/artifact-dirs.txt` — the canonical list of agent artifact
  directories (SpecStory, Claude plans, Cursor plans + rules, OpenCode
  plans, Spec-kit, Codex). Consumed by `stage-agent-artifacts.sh` and
  by `bootstrap-project.sh` when rendering the pre-commit `files:`
  regex.
- `assets/pre-commit-config.yaml.template` — minimal
  `.pre-commit-config.yaml` with `redact-agent-secrets` + gitleaks +
  standard hygiene hooks.
- `assets/gitleaks.toml.template` — portable subset of the chezmoi
  `.gitleaks.toml` with custom rule IDs + a path-scoped allowlist for
  agent artifact dirs.
- `assets/redact_secrets.py` — bundled copy of chezmoi's
  `scripts/redact_secrets.py`. Chezmoi version is upstream; sync doc
  in `references/pre-commit-redaction-stack.md`.

  — SpecStory / Claude session layouts and the `$PWD → slug` algorithm.

## Recommended implementation plan

### 1. Define the managed HUD policy

Add `C:\Users\hanruzhou\.local\share\chezmoi\claude\hud-full-overlay.json`. Because `claude/**` is chezmoi-ignored, embed it with `{{ include }}` in the existing run-onchange template so changes affect the rendered script hash.

Document it as **“Full as of claude-hud 0.7.1”**, reviewed from `commands/configure.md`, rather than deriving it from `DEFAULT_CONFIG`.

Managed leaves should be:

- Core/project: `display.showModel`, `showProject`, `showContextBar`
- Activity: `showTools`, `showSkills`, `showMcp`, `showAgents`, `showTodos`
- Information: `showAddedDirs`, `showConfigCounts`, `showTokenBreakdown`, `showUsage`, `showResetLabel`, `showCost`, `showDuration`, `showSessionName`, `showSessionTokens`, `showEffortLevel`, `showOutputStyle`, `showMemoryUsage`, `showPromptCache`, `showClaudeCodeVersion`, `showCompactions`, `showAdvisor`
- Git: `gitStatus.enabled = true`, `showDirty = true`, `showAheadBehind = false`
- Jujutsu: `jjStatus.enabled = true`, `showDirty = true`, `showConflicts = true`

All other leaves remain user-owned, including:

- `display.showRoutedCost`, `showSpeed`, auth/account/provider settings
- Layout, language, element ordering, merge groups, usage style/value
- Thresholds, external usage paths, prompt cache TTL
- Colors, custom text, model/advisor overrides
- Session dates and last-response time
- `gitStatus.showFileStats`, branch overflow, and push thresholds

This gives managed Full leaves overlay precedence while preserving the rest of the live config recursively.

# Context

The current Claude integration enables `claude-hud` and installs a status-line command, but it never manages the plugin’s stable `plugins/claude-hud/config.json`; the machine therefore receives HUD defaults rather than the documented Full display preset. The status-line launcher can also emit errors during the first-launch gap before Claude materializes the plugin cache. Separately, `claude-copilot` promises a hands-off bypass-permissions flow, but its SpecStory zero-argument branch delegates to a create-seeded, user-editable TOML file and can launch plain `claude`. The goal is to make the HUD Full preset deterministic while preserving advanced user settings, and to make the Copilot wrapper enforce its own bypass contract without converting SpecStory’s user config into a fully managed file.

## 1. Manage the Claude HUD Full preset as a narrow overlay

- Add `claude/hud-full-overlay.json`, embedded into the existing run-onchange script so its content participates in chezmoi’s rendered-script hash (`claude/**` is intentionally ignored as a direct deployment source).
- Define and document the owned key set as **“Full as of claude-hud 0.7.1”**, because upstream exposes Full only as prose in `/claude-hud:configure`, not as a JSON Schema or preset constant.
- Own only the documented Full leaves:
  - core/activity: model, project, added directories, context, tools, skills, MCP, agents, todos;
  - information: config counts, token breakdown, usage/reset label, cost, duration, session name/tokens, effort, output style, memory, prompt cache, Claude Code version, compactions, advisor;
  - Git: enabled + dirty, with ahead/behind disabled;
  - Jujutsu: enabled + dirty/conflicts.
- Preserve all advanced and future live keys, including layout/order, colors, thresholds, prompt-cache TTL, routed cost, speed, auth/provider fields, external usage paths, custom text, model/advisor overrides, and unknown nested keys.

## 2. Extend and harden the existing Claude JSON merger

Modify `.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_25_claude_settings.ps1.tmpl`; do not add a second run script.

- Embed both `claude/settings-overlay.json` and `claude/hud-full-overlay.json` at render time.
- Refactor reusable JSON operations into helpers:
  - read an absent/blank file as an empty object and reject malformed/non-object JSON;
  - recursively merge objects with overlay leaves winning and live-only keys surviving;
  - retain the existing special additive/deduplicating `Merge-ClaudeHooks` behavior for `settings.json` only;
  - serialize, parse-validate, and atomically replace through a same-directory temporary file using BOM-free UTF-8; avoid rewriting when bytes are already normalized.
- Process two independent transactions under separate `try/catch` blocks:
  1. `$CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/settings.json`, including sound-hook creation/pruning;
  2. `$CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/plugins/claude-hud/config.json`, using ordinary recursive merge.
- Fail closed per target: malformed settings must remain byte-for-byte untouched while HUD still updates, and malformed HUD config must not block settings. Warnings remain nonfatal so chezmoi apply never aborts.
- Harden both JSON targets with the shared atomic writer rather than leaving the existing direct `Set-Content` path for settings.

## 3. Make the status-line launcher safe during plugin bootstrap

Update `claude/settings-overlay.json` while retaining its Git Bash/Cygwin, `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`, semantic-version cache selection, width fallback, and Node behavior.

- Resolve Node and the newest cached `claude-hud/dist/index.js` first.
- Exit successfully with no output when Node, the cache directory, or `dist/index.js` is missing.
- Execute Node only after all prerequisites are present. This turns the first-launch cache race into a temporary blank status line instead of a module-not-found error.

## 4. Keep SpecStory config user-owned and harden the wrapper

Modify `dot_config/powershell/modules/Copilot/Copilot.psm1`; leave `private_dot_specstory/private_cli/create_config.toml` and project `.specstory/cli/config.toml` unchanged.

- Preserve the ownership boundary: direct `specstory run claude` remains governed by user/project configuration; no TOML merger or full-file override is introduced.
